Title: Login with valid username and password
Steps: 1. Open /user/login 2. Enter username and password 3. Click Sign In

Title: Login with email instead of username
Steps: 1. Open login 2. Enter email and password 3. Sign In

Title: Login with wrong password
Steps: 1. Enter valid username 2. Enter wrong password 3. Sign In
Expected Result: Error 'Username or password is incorrect.'; stays on login page

Title: Login with unknown username shows same generic error
Steps: 1. Enter unregistered username 2. Any password 3. Sign In
Expected Result: Same generic error as wrong password (no account enumeration)

Title: Login with empty username
Steps: 1. Leave username empty 2. Enter password 3. Sign In
Expected Result: Form not submitted; required-field validation shown

Title: Password input is masked
Steps: 1. Open login 2. Type in password field

Title: Logout ends the session
Steps: 1. Open user menu 2. Sign Out 3. Open /repo/create
Expected Result: Signed out; protected page redirects to login

Title: Register with valid details
Steps: 1. Open /user/sign_up 2. Fill username, email, password, confirm 3. Register
Expected Result: Success message, user logged in, row in DB with hashed password

Title: Password shorter than 8 characters
Expected Result: Error 'Password length cannot be less than 8 characters.'

Title: Password and confirmation do not match
Steps: 1. Enter different values in password and confirm 2. Register

Title: Email already used, different letter case
Steps: 1. Register with existing email in upper case
Expected Result: Error 'The email address is already used.'

Title: Malformed email address
Expected Result: Browser blocks submit; email format error

Title: Username longer than 40 characters
Expected Result: Rejected with validation error; 40 characters accepted

Title: Create public repository
Steps: 1. + > New Repository 2. Enter name and description 3. Create
Expected Result: Repo page opens; no Private badge; API shows private=false

Title: Create private repository
Expected Result: Private badge shown; DB is_private = true

Title: Duplicate repository name
Steps: 1. Create repo with an existing name
Expected Result: Error 'The repository name is already used.'

Title: Invalid characters in name
Steps: 1. Create repo named with space / ';' / ending '.git'

Title: Name length limit 100
Expected Result: Field holds only 100 characters; API rejects 101

Title: Create issue with title and description
Steps: 1. Issues > New Issue 2. Enter title and description 3. Create Issue
Expected Result: Issue #1 opens with state Open; body shown

Title: Create issue with empty title
Steps: 1. New Issue 2. Leave title empty 3. Create

Title: Create issue with whitespace-only title
Steps: 1. New Issue 2. Title = spaces only 3. Create (UI and API)
Expected Result: Rejected with 'Title cannot be empty' in UI and 422 in API

Title: Title of 256 characters
Steps: 1. Create issue with 256-character title via API; try typing 300 characters in UI
Expected Result: API rejects with 422; UI field stops at 255

Title: Title with HTML/script and SQL characters
Steps: 1. Create issue with <script> and SQL text as title 2. Open issue
Expected Result: Stored literally; no script runs; DB intact

Title: Create issue without being logged in
Create issue in a repository that does not exist
Add a comment
Expected Result: Comment appears in timeline; DB num_comments +1

Title: Close an issue
Expected Result: State Closed; repo open count decreases; closed_at set

Title: Filter issue list by state
Expected Result: Each filter returns only matching issues

Title: Read-only token cannot write
Steps: 1. GET repo with token 2. POST issue with token

Title: Private repo hidden from anonymous users
Duplicate label names in one repository
UI-created issue matches DB row
Steps: 1. Create issue in UI 2. SELECT with JOIN on repository and user
Expected Result: Title, body, author, repo match exactly

Title: Repository counters match issue rows
Steps: 1. Create 3, close 1 2. Compare num_issues/num_closed_issues with COUNT(*)

Title: Deleting a repo leaves no orphan issues
Steps: 1. Delete repo 2. Count issues by repo_id
